meta.name: aed:exit-intent
meta.description: Master switch. Set content to 'on' to arm the modal. Without this meta tag exit intent never fires.

json.description: Copy and trigger thresholds for the exit-intent modal. All fields optional.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the headline. Empty string to hide.

body.default: Got 30 seconds? See if we'd be a fit — no pitch, no pressure.

primary.href.description: Primary action URL. May be a 'javascript:' bridge to other addons (e.g. void(__booking.open())).

secondary.dismiss.description: How a secondary click is remembered. 'session' re-arms next visit; 'permanent' suppresses forever.

dwellMs.description: Milliseconds after page load before the modal can fire (engagement window).

minScrollPercent.description: Minimum scroll depth (0–100) required before arming. 0 = no scroll required.

hideOnPaths.description: Paths where the modal must never fire.
